query: We found powershell.exe running with an encoded base64 command spawned from winword.exe, then an outbound connection to an unfamiliar external IP.
Multiple file servers show mass file renaming with a new extension and a ransom note appeared. vssadmin.exe was executed with 'delete shadows' shortly before.
